title: SAN JUAN SUNSET
style: Style: Latin chill-pop, nylon guitar, light percussion
lyrics:
[Intro — ocean waves, nylon guitar]

Mar y sol… música…

[Verse 1]

Painted skies in foreign light
Songs are born in coastal nights
Wooden stage, barefoot sound
Every soul is gathered round

[Verse 2]

From NZ roads to ocean sand
She carries songs across the land

[Pre-Chorus]

Different towns, same heart
Every ending is a start

[Chorus]

Under every sunset sky
She finds wings and learns to fly
Aquí estoy, I belong
Everywhere I sing my song

[Bridge]

Mi voz, mi fe
My truth, my way

[Final Chorus]
[Outro]

Sunset… fade out…
